name: stochasticTiling
description: Seamlessly warps the UV0 ('Tiled') texture coordinates with a random vector field and modulates the base color over a large scale to break up visible texture repetition. UV1 ('Unwrapped') is not affected.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Enables stochastic tiling for UV0. Disabled by default.

properties.name: strength
properties.description: How strongly the texture coordinates are warped. Higher values break up repetition more, but can visibly stretch texture details.

properties.name: scale
properties.description: Frequency of the warp field. Lower values spread the distortion over more tiles (smoother), higher values make it more chaotic.

properties.name: variationStrength
properties.description: Modulates the base color brightness over a large, world-space scale that is independent of the texture tiling. Very effective against repetition at a distance. 0 disables.

properties.name: variationScale
properties.description: World-space size of a macro variation patch, in meters.
